title: The Phantom of the Opera (1925), Rupert Julian, starring Lon Chaney
contents: Christine pulls off the Phantom's mask, revealing Lon Chaney's skull-like face — one of the great shock reveals in film history.
license: US: PD. Korea: PD (70 years from publication). Note: Chaney's makeup design is part of the film.
